name: io.recall365/recall365
title: Recall365 — Global Product Recalls
description: Search official product recalls from US, EU, UK, CA, AU, JP, KR, CN regulators and FDA red lists.

tools.name: search_recalls
tools.description: Search official product recalls by keyword (product, brand, hazard; Chinese/English/Korean brand names are cross-matched). Returns at most 20 newest/most relevant notices with links.

query.description: Keyword, e.g. 'power bank', '婴儿床', 'BMW'. Optional if filters are given.

country.description: Recall market ISO code, e.g. US, EU, UK, CA, AU, NZ, JP, KR, CN.

made_in_china.description: Only products whose origin is China.

border_rejection.description: Only EU RASFF border rejections (food refused at the EU border, not recalled).

lang.description: Output language: zh = 中文, en = English. Default en.

tools.name: get_recall
tools.description: Full detail of one recall by its Recall365 id: product, brand, hazard, failed standards, remedy, official notice link.

lang.description: Output language: zh = 中文, en = English. Default en.

tools.name: brand_recall_history
tools.description: Recall history of a brand across all markets: totals by year, country and category, plus the 10 latest notices.

lang.description: Output language: zh = 中文, en = English. Default en.

tools.name: precheck_product
tools.description: Risk profile for a product type before selling it abroad: recalls in the last 3 years, share made in China, top hazards, top markets, yearly trend, typical cases and self-check advice.

country.description: Recall market ISO code, e.g. US, EU, UK, CA, AU, NZ, JP, KR, CN.

lang.description: Output language: zh = 中文, en = English. Default en.

tools.name: fda_import_alerts
tools.description: Search the FDA Import Alert red lists: firms whose products can be detained at the US border without physical examination. Search by firm name, city or product (e.g. 'laser', 'eye shadow', 'Shenzhen'). Defaults to firms in China.

query.description: Firm name, city or product keyword. Optional.

country.description: ISO code (CN default, HK, IN, VN…) or ALL.

lang.description: Output language: zh = 中文, en = English. Default en.

tools.name: data_coverage
tools.description: Which official sources are covered, record counts, and the latest publish date per source (how fresh the data is).
